Definition: Zabad, the name of seven Israelites
BiblicalUsage: Zabad is named 8 times in the Bible, and the passages here are 1 Chronicles 2:36; 2 Chronicles 24:26; Ezra 10:27. In 1 Chronicles 2:36 we read, "And Attai begat Nathan, and Nathan begat Zabad,". The same name belongs to more than one man, and Ezra 10:27 names another of them.
TheologicalSignificance: Zabad belonged to someone God knew, and I hold that every name in these lists did. The record keeps him, and I am glad it does.
RelatedPeople: Zabad, Son of Nathan; Zabad, Son of Shimeath; Zabad, Son of Zattu
